require 'sinatra' require 'json' require 'securerandom' require 'cgi' require 'net/http' require 'uri' require 'rack/utils' set :port, 4567 set :bind, '0.0.0.0' # Cross-service auth token store AUTH_TOKENS = {} # Require secrets to be provided via environment; fail fast if missing. def require_secret(env_key) value = ENV[env_key] if value.nil? || value.empty? raise "Missing required environment variable: #{env_key}" end value end SERVICE_REGISTRY = { 'dashboard' => { url: 'http://dashboard:3000', shared_secret: require_secret('DASHBOARD_SECRET') }, 'analytics' => { url: 'http://analytics:3001', shared_secret: require_secret('ANALYTICS_SECRET') } } # Middleware for service-to-service auth before do content_type :json if request.path_info.start_with?('/internal/') token = request.env['HTTP_X_SERVICE_TOKEN'] halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless valid_service_token?(token) end end def valid_service_token?(token) return false if token.nil? || token.empty? AUTH_TOKENS.values.any? { |t| Rack::Utils.secure_compare(t, token) } end def generate_service_token(service_name) token = SecureRandom.hex(32) AUTH_TOKENS[service_name] = token token end # Safely parse a JSON request body, returning nil on failure. def parse_json_body(body) JSON.parse(body) rescue JSON::ParserError nil end # HTML template renderer for error pages and redirects module SafeRenderer ALLOWED_SCHEMES = ['http', 'https'].freeze def self.encode_html_attribute(value) value.to_s.gsub(/[&"'<>]/, { '&' => '&', '"' => '"', "'" => ''', '<' => '<', '>' => '>' }) end def self.encode_html_content(value) CGI.escapeHTML(value.to_s) end def self.safe_url?(url) parsed = URI.parse(url) ALLOWED_SCHEMES.include?(parsed.scheme) rescue URI::InvalidURIError false end def self.render_redirect_page(target_url, service_name, user_context) # Build the page with proper encoding encoded_url = encode_html_attribute(target_url) encoded_service = encode_html_content(service_name) # User context is pre-validated JSON from trusted service context_json = user_context.to_json <<~HTML Redirecting to #{encoded_service}

Redirecting to #{encoded_service}...

HTML end end # Service authentication endpoint post '/auth/service' do data = parse_json_body(request.body.read) halt 400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json if data.nil? service_name = data['service'] secret = data['secret'] unless SERVICE_REGISTRY.key?(service_name) halt 404, { error: 'Unknown service' }.to_json end stored_secret = SERVICE_REGISTRY[service_name][:shared_secret] unless secret.is_a?(String) && Rack::Utils.secure_compare(stored_secret, secret) halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json end token = generate_service_token(service_name) { token: token, expires_in: 3600 }.to_json end # Internal endpoint: receive user context from dashboard service post '/internal/user-context' do data = parse_json_body(request.body.read) halt 400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json if data.nil? session_id = data['session_id'] user_context = data['user_context'] # Validate and sanitize user context fields sanitized_context = {} if user_context.is_a?(Hash) # Only allow known safe fields with strict validation if user_context['display_name'].is_a?(String) # Strip any HTML/script content and limit length name = user_context['display_name'].gsub(/<[^>]*>/, '').strip[0..64] sanitized_context['display_name'] = name end end $user_contexts ||= {} $user_contexts[session_id] = sanitized_context { status: 'stored' }.to_json end # Cross-service redirect with user context get '/redirect/:service' do service_name = params[:service] session_id = params[:sid] unless SERVICE_REGISTRY.key?(service_name) halt 404, { error: 'Unknown service' }.to_json end target_url = SERVICE_REGISTRY[service_name][:url] + '/home' unless SafeRenderer.safe_url?(target_url) halt 400, { error: 'Invalid redirect target' }.to_json end $user_contexts ||= {} user_context = $user_contexts[session_id] || { 'display_name' => 'User' } content_type :html SafeRenderer.render_redirect_page(target_url, service_name, user_context) end # Health check get '/health' do { status: 'ok', services: SERVICE_REGISTRY.keys }.to_json end
